stem: Which line from the selection provides the best evidence that Paul's mother has remarried more than once?

options.label: A
options.text: He had been almost sure—as sure as he ever was of anything—that he should find her at home when he arrived. . . .

options.label: B
options.text: It was the first time he had seen the new hôtel which his step-father had bought, and in which Mr. and Mrs. Moffatt had hastily established themselves. . . .

options.label: C
options.text: His mother had become Mrs. Moffatt, and the father he had been most used to, and liked best, had abruptly disappeared from his life. . . .

options.label: D
options.text: Paul never knew where they were except when a telegram announced that they were going somewhere else.
